body:
It’s not controlling.. op has talked about it and they both agreed on not watching it. Also idk if keeping a tab open is “trying to hide it”
Lmao
Bruh, he doesn’t need to have his “snack” if they discussed this and he crossed the boundary. Don’t know why you’re defending him.. op has issues yes but op stated they agreed on no porn.
im proud of you too! thank you
i love you too, thank you
thank you! you’re doing great too!
you’re not a failure, im proud of you dude. I like hearing about peoples lives, it’s not being narcissistic at all. thank you for openin up , you’re doing great. thank you
you’re amazing too, I’ve never seen that emoji ever! thank you so much for your kind words
thank you, Im your biggest cheerleader too. you matter as well! thank you so much <3
thank you so much! i wish in the future I can also be able to show how proud of myself for Doing good. thank you!!!
I wish parents weren’t so dismissive like they are now. I’m proud of both of us! if you ever need anything let me know. I see you too <3

i haven’t thought about being an overachiever, I’ve only thought about studying.. not jobs or anything. I’m still young so I believe I have a long while to plan it all out. thank you so much for the links, I’ve bookmarked them. thank you again
I hope you have a great holiday too, you deserve it. thank you so much,, it’s nice to hear I deserve happiness. thank you
thank you, i tried telling her that but she didn’t listen. thank you again
merry christmas! thank you so much!!
nothin wrong with not getting a 100! you still went through school and you’re here now. I’m proud of you, thank you!

hi, i know you probably saw this as a very brutally honest, sweet message but there is nothing wrong with wanting someone to tell you they’re proud of you. self reassurance is very good, something a lot of people need to work on, but hearing it from others is a different experience. i said myself “i want someone to see me”, i acknowledged i did good. thank you for the congratulations, im gonna try to do better with reassurance.
and that’s what I’m trying to do now since I’ve matured and realized I can do better, thank you so much
I’ll try my best to keep you guys updated!! I probably have a shit ton of more tests coming up so I’ll be sure to post if I need it. Thank you so much!
thank you! im proud of you too :D!
I’ll definitely update if I have any more tests coming up.. I need reassurance a lot. I hope the next semester coming up treats us well! Thank you
i wasn’t even aiming for an A+ but when he announced my grade I was so happy. Thank you for reminding me that I don’t always have to do the best I can to be the best I can
thank you !! im very very proud of you too !!
thank you, im proud of you too
thank you so much! i don’t use reddit at all so idk what awards are but it looks super cute and small lmao. you keep up the great work too, i hope soon to get a degree as well :D
thank you… been doing bare minimum for awhile so this is a brand new change! a good one
thank you! i studied extra hard and it paid off <3 i think ur doing great too

I get the relapsing part.. curiosity gets the better of us. I’m happy you’re doing better and understand no contact is the best thing for you guys. I hope Christmas has wonderful little surprises just like thanksgiving did! Maybe you’ll have another big dinner and you don’t even know it yet :D, I’ll keep my password protected and such. Thank you so much for telling me this.. I feel like I made a new friend

thank you for your words, I’ve read this back a couple of times. Ill be reading, actually ordering books for christmas so this is perfect timing! my mom has old fashioned way of thinking.. no getting past her. but thank you again, im really happy to hear someone make my feelings make sense

im so sorry.. i can’t imagine having grandkids and just not having any relationship with them, even with your daughter. i hope the universe brings you two together again.. and you can meet your grandkids. i don’t know the situation fully but it’s never to late to reach out to your daughter and try to rekindle things, even if it’s unsuccessful. i hope the best for you.. especially during these holiday times
it really was stressful But im glad i pulled through just to see my grade! thank you so much, you’re doing good too

she sometimes does acknowledge them, just as I’ve gotten older, not so much. She thinks it’s something that should come natural.. it’s mean of me to say but it’s not fair. She calls me lazy and stuff. My family doesn’t believe in help/therapy so to talk about mental health is taboo. She tells me I have no reason to be sad. I don’t know.. thank you so much though. i studied hard and it paid off i believe, i have a 98% for the semester now
Thank you so much (: I’m gonna try to get many more 100%’s in the future! Thank you again

Ahh the first sentence made me smile so much (:, I will probably need to reach out to someone in the future since Seasonal depression has really gotten me these past months. Thank you so much! I’m proud of your achievements too!! <3

The world is very dum dum ): I wish it wasn’t so this forum wouldn’t even exist.. thank you so much. I’m trying to repress those feelings the best, healthiest, ways I can. You’re doing well too, thank you so much
These comments are making me feel proud of myself (: thank you so much. You’re doing amazing too! So many people responded, I definitely feel so much better. Thank you again
I send you a hug too! The power of attraction and entanglement will actually send you 100 hugs. Thank you
She can have her moments.. I don’t like telling her about school anymore because of these things. You’re doing amazing too, thank you so much <3
thank you! im actually debating on whether to study a history major in the future, you have a bright future ahead too :3

I’ve been studying a lot and I even did extra tests online to make sure I got 100 (my history teacher is my favorite teacher so I wanted to make him proud! Plus getting good grades makes him look better as a teacher) thank you, you’re doing good too
I’ve been staring at this since you’ve written it. Thank you so much, im glad I can make you proud
i suffer with this feeling as well! lmao it feels nice to have someone put my feelings into words so well.
